name: Kozakai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kozakai town emblem in red: two discs flanking a stylised device of two curved strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Kozakai in Aichi Prefecture, dissolved on 2010-02-01. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1972.

features.role: Kozakai town emblem — two discs flanking a stylised device of two curved strokes
